'''August 2000 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Broken Games, Seattle, WA on 12 August 2000. [[Ben Rich]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1116">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-13-seattle-wa-8-12-00d1116/ seattle-wa-8-12-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 13 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-13-seattle-wa-8-12-00d1116/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Ben Rich]]
